output.summary: A large deciduous tree native at least to southwest and central Asia and southeast Europe, though ancient cultivation obscures its exact natural range. Its fruit has a green husk around a corrugated shell and a rich-flavoured edible nut; cultivated trees usually have thinner shells than wild ones.
output.edibilityNote: The nuts are eaten fresh or pressed for richly flavoured oil; cultivated forms are commonly selected for larger, thinner-shelled nuts.
